notes: Gateway-MySQL mode, azure-only, single-operator internal use (NOT resold, NOT billed). The GitHub Copilot upstream credential (a long-lived GitHub OAuth token) lives in provider_accounts.access_token (provider_type='copilot'), read via v_proxy_accounts_v1 (agent-gateway mig 166 + the copilot_api access_token/provider_type column grants in mig 169); copilot-api performs its own GitHub->Copilot ephemeral-token exchange at runtime and never writes access_token. stateful=false + stateDir=null on purpose: the credential is NOT a local file, so the container must deploy and health-check green (GET / -> 200) while IDLE, BEFORE any credential exists — the operator imports the Copilot account through the gateway admin UI AFTER the system is live. Only individual Copilot requests fail (gracefully) until then. COPILOT_API_HOME file/env is kept ONLY as a documented loopback / no-gateway fallback and is not required for the container to start. overlapSafe=false: the GitHub->Copilot token refresh loop is a per-process background writer (no shared single-writer lock yet); promote once audited. First deploy is a cold docker-run bootstrap. Requires agent-gateway deployed first on the same host (copilot_api grants mig 168 + 169, pin-lookup routing, nginx X-Backend: copilot-api -> 127.0.0.1:39526).
